requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 TM1637 + A0 + 按钮（D2）：默认显示电位器值，按下显示 8888
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: io_1=false, set io_0 to two different values (e.g., 1234.0 then 4321.0)
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_2 equals floor(io_0) each step (e.g., 1234 then 4321) while button not pressed

requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text: 使用 TM1637 + A0 + 按钮（D2）：默认显示电位器值，按下显示 8888
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: Hold io_1=true (pressed) while changing io_0 across values
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_2 is always 8888 regardless of io_0 while button is pressed
